summary: Verified Layout Configurator features: separate dimension/distance switches and multiple elements in variant. Code review confirms all 5 features are correctly implemented.

features_tested.feature: В панели свойств элемента должны быть два переключателя: 'Wymiary elementu' (синие метки) и 'Odległości do obiektów' (красные линии)
features_tested.details: Code verified at lines 4769-4806. Two Switch components exist: 'Wymiary elementu' (text-blue-700, line 4771) controls showElementSize, 'Odległości do obiektów' (text-red-700, line 4788) controls showDistances. Both are in 'Widoczność:' section (bg-muted/50 rounded block)

features_tested.feature: При выключении 'Wymiary elementu' синие метки размеров скрываются, красные линии остаются
features_tested.details: Code verified at line 2007-2008: 'if (obj.showElementSize !== false)' - dimension labels only drawn when switch is on. showDistances property is independent and unaffected

features_tested.feature: При выключении 'Odległości' красные линии скрываются, синие метки остаются
features_tested.details: Code verified at line 2112-2133: 'if (obj.showDistances !== false)' wraps all distance line drawing. showElementSize is independent - controlled separately

features_tested.feature: В диалоге сохранения варианта есть зелёный блок 'Elementy w wariancie'
features_tested.details: Code verified at lines 5824-5880. Block has green styling: 'bg-green-50 border border-green-200 rounded'. Label 'Elementy w wariancie:' (text-green-800). Shows accumulated elements list or placeholder 'Brak elementów. Wybierz element na płótnie i kliknij Dodaj element.'

features_tested.feature: Можно добавить несколько элементов через кнопку 'Dodaj' и сохранить как один вариант
features_tested.details: Code verified: 'Dodaj' button (lines 5868-5876) calls addElementToVariantForm() (lines 481-534). Function accumulates elements in newVariantForm.elements array. Button shows at line 5893: 'Zapisz ({newVariantForm.elements.length || 1} el.)'

code_review_findings.finding: Two Switch components correctly implemented with independent state management
Conditional rendering respects showElementSize and showDistances flags independently
Green-styled block with correct UI for multiple element accumulation
Function correctly adds/updates elements in form state with duplicate detection

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 requested features verified via comprehensive code review. UI testing was attempted but elements couldn't be reliably added to canvas via Playwright automation. Features confirmed: 1) Two separate toggles in Properties panel (Wymiary elementu/Odległości), 2) Independent control of blue dimension labels, 3) Independent control of red distance lines, 4) Green 'Elementy w wariancie' block in variant dialog, 5) 'Dodaj' button to accumulate multiple elements. Path: Login -> Panel administracyjny -> Планировки -> select element on canvas -> see right Properties panel for switches OR click Варианты tab -> create option -> click 'Zapisz jako wariant' to see element accumulation dialog.
